channel.description: New summaries and incidents confirmed by several sources in Russia's war in Ukraine.

item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine has stepped up drone attacks on the Kerch bridge, causing a partial collapse, while Russia has pledged to rebuild the structure stronger. Russian forces have struck Odesa, killing four civilians, and a separate Russian strike killed a Ukrainian mother, an athlete and a drone operator. High casualty levels persist, with 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP. The conflict remains concentrated in occupied Crimea and southern Ukraine, driven by ongoing Russian military operations and Ukrainian retaliatory strikes.
